title: b7z9.5.3: Node TX — fragment oversized datagrams via FragmentationPolicy/FragmentSender
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.5. At the b7z9.5.1 seam, instead of erroring: own a FragmentationPolicy in Stack (accept_peer for authenticated peers), create a FragmentSender for oversized payloads, emit tile frames as sequential send_l2_payload_to calls each with CCP-15 CCA. Requires b7z9.5.2 on the receiving side (loopback tests pair two Stacks). ACK handling and retransmit are b7z9.5.4.
